note: USACE campground on Rathbun Lake (11,000 acres, 'Iowa's Ocean') 13 miles northwest of Centerville, off Highway J18. The main loop sits in open woods back from the shore; the 16-site F loop to the east is on open grass above the lake, F11 at the water's edge. Boat ramp, fish cleaning station, playground. --Claude
summary: Fees changed 22/22 -> 15/28 (2026 rec.gov rates); hookups electric 50, 106 sites, facilities confirmed; max rig 89 -> 159 (posted pull-through) with note; booking platform/url/14-night rolling rule added. Lakefront kept (F11, official photo + imagery). PIN ~370 m off. Possible split of the F loop flagged. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront kept): rec.gov's official photo of F11 shows its pad running onto open grass with the open lake just beyond; imagery puts F11's pad end ~15-25 m from the shore bank with no road between. F12, F13 and F15 photos look across open grass to the lake (lakeview); F10 ~40-50 m. Candidates: 1 on-water (F11), 3-4 lakeview in the F loop; R06 has a lake glimpse through trees. The 87-site main circle is wooded and ~100+ m back behind its loop road - not waterfront.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: the 16-site F loop (rec.gov loop 'BBIC', centroid 40.87663,-93.01260) is ~1.6 km east of the 87-site main circle (loop 'BCIR', centroid 40.87479,-93.03058) and is reached by a separate road from the north-east park road; I could not confirm from rec.gov whether it has its own entrance or shares the Bridgeview gate. If it is a separate place, it is the lakefront half and the main circle is not waterfront.
PIN: stored 40.87220,-93.02950 is on the shore south of the main circle, ~370 m from the loop centre. Correct to 40.8748,-93.0306 (main circle).
PHONE: stored 641-647-2464 is rec.gov's closed-season line; during May-September rec.gov gives 641-724-3062 for the campground. apply.py does not write phone.
SEASON: rec.gov states no campground season; the rate season is May 1 - Sept 29 and the 2027 calendar shows sites available from May 1. Stored derived year_round false left alone.

FEES: base is the $15 non-electric rate (R06/R08 reservable, 48 and 55 ft, fit a 23-ft motorhome); the $50 double site is excluded from nightly_high. rec.gov militaryDiscount rule value not written as a discount.
SITES: 9 catalog records (B24, M13-M15, Q05, Q06, Q09, Q10) are 'Not Available' and unreservable; the rec.gov text still says 106 family sites, which stays as the count.
